proposed.choice: The Node CLI supervises one Rust engine subprocess; that engine supervises D2, and the static reader runs independently.
proposed.rationale: One engine owns capture through publication and recovery; bounded versioned JSON carries operation control and truthful outcomes across the adapter boundary.
alternatives: A hosted browsing service required for reading.
consequences: Response loss after a potentially mutating launch requires recovery inspection, not an unchanged-output claim or automatic retry.
No new service or Module is implied by a role or skill.
The renderer receives only safe generated input and bundled resources; no model-directed network access.
Proposed execution only; existing observed CLI runtime remains unchanged.
revisit_when: A selected requirement, supported platform or actual qualification result defeats this realization.
